project.name: Credit-Score-investment-advisor
project.description: Financial Credit Scoring and Investment Advisory System (Nivesh Mitra)

nodes.name: generate_synthetic_data.py
nodes.summary: Data Generation Module -- Creates synthetic user credit profiles, financial metrics, and investment preferences into CSV dataset.

nodes.name: synthetic_users.csv
nodes.summary: Financial Dataset -- Contains user demographic, credit history, income, loan defaults, and investment profile data.

nodes.name: model.py
nodes.summary: Credit Risk ML Model -- Trains Random Forest Classifier on synthetic credit profiles to predict credit scores and risk tiers.

nodes.name: explain.py
nodes.summary: Model Explainability -- Uses SHAP and feature importance values to generate user-friendly credit score decision factors.

nodes.name: credit_model.pkl
nodes.summary: Trained Model Weights -- Serialized Random Forest machine learning pipeline for fast scoring inference.

nodes.name: nivesh_mitra.py
nodes.summary: Investment Recommendation Engine -- Core advisor rule base recommending stocks, mutual funds, gold, and FDs based on credit score.

nodes.name: growth_projection.py
nodes.summary: Compound Interest and Portfolio Calculator -- Projects multi-year asset growth, risk-adjusted returns, and SIP scenarios.

nodes.name: main.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI REST Server -- API Gateway connecting frontend UI requests to credit scoring models and Nivesh Mitra advisor services.

nodes.name: app.py
nodes.summary: Streamlit Interactive Web Dashboard -- User interface for entering financial metrics, displaying credit score radar charts, and investment strategies.

nodes.name: requirements.txt
nodes.summary: Backend Dependency Specs -- Defines FastAPI, uvicorn, scikit-learn, pandas, numpy, and shap versions.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project Documentation -- Installation instructions, architecture overview, and API endpoint documentation.
